text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*, so sleepy!
Time to go encounter my bed~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What's this?
An UmaTube notification...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A live DJ stream?!
Right now?! For real?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No way, this is no time to be sleeping!!
Hang on, gotta grab snacks and drinks on standby☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios ended up staying up late
after watching a popular UmaTuber's livestream...
